title: Improving the 26-Round GIFT Attack
summary: A 26-round attack on GIFT is known, while applying the proposed key-guessing framework to improve it remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Can the proposed key-guessing framework improve the 26-round GIFT attack of [20]?

scope.domain: Key-guessing cryptanalysis of the GIFT block cipher.
parameters: 26 rounds: round count of the GIFT attack targeted for improvement
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the proposed key-guessing framework can improve the 26-round GIFT attack of [20].

progress.summary: The authors express confidence that their techniques can improve the new best GIFT attack in [20], but they do not construct that improvement.
citation_labels: Marek Broll et al., Generic Framework for Key-Guessing Improvements
